notes.title: v2.0.0 - The Multi-Peter Update
notes.content: [p]After months of work and playtesting, the Multi-Peter update is officially here! [/p][p][/p][p]Big thanks to everyone who participated in the beta and submitted bug reports. I am fairly confident v2.0.0 is stable, but I will continue to monitor the megathread on the Steam community board and release hotfixes when necessary.[/p][p][/p][p]And now...[/p][h1]\[ ----- v2.0.0 PATCH NOTES ----- ][/h1][p][/p][h3]NEW FEATURES[/h3][list][*][p]Online multiplayer has been added![/p][list][*][p]Access via the "PLAY ONLINE" door, left of the title logo[/p][/*][*][p]Steam P2P 1-4 players[/p][/*][*][p]All game modes are temporarily unlocked while playing online[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added "Map view" mode (press F9 to the Alien scene[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues involving 2 Peters grabbing each other at the same time[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Peters could sometimes respawn in Story mode[/p][/*][/list][h3]GENERAL MECHANICS CHANGES[/h3][list][*][p]Tech frame window: 6 -> 10[/p][/*][*][p]Fast falling can be initiated slightly earlier (vspeed<=gravity -> tags.feature: Online multiplayer has been added!
Access via the "PLAY ONLINE" door, left of the title logo
Steam P2P lobbies can be created and joined
LAN/Direct IP is also supported
Upon starting a lobby, you can quickly select a mode
All game modes now support 1-4 players
All game modes are temporarily unlocked while playing online
Added "Map view" mode (press F9 to toggle)

tags.bug: Fixed the permanent blue background when calling Bug repeatedly
Gamepad rumble option now works correctly
Fixed some settings not saving correctly
Fixed an issue where bgm_lurking would play for 1 frame before the area music starts
Fixed an issue where screenshake would last forever after the Alien scene
Fixed issues involving 2 Peters grabbing each other at the same time
Fixed an issue where Peters could sometimes respawn in Story mode

tags.balance_change: Tech frame window: 6 -> 10
Fast falling can be initiated slightly earlier (vspeed<=gravity -> vspeed<=-gravity)
Grabs can be parried now (Guard can still be grabbed)
CPU Peters can charge attacks now
CPU Peters will try to use Utilt more
Egg bombs can now light bomb block wicks
Bug can now lift objects a short distance
Bug can now be hit by Peter in Co-op mode
Bug can also hit Peter in Co-op mode
Removed Performance mode due to complications with netcode
Optimized object activation code to compensate
Banana peels can be destroyed now (10 hp)
Icicles can now be grabbed and thrown
Local & Online co-op is supported
Two gamepads must be connected to access co-op setup
When playing in co-op, the first two in-game cutscenes will not play
Peter's current form now saves & loads at save points
This also applies to co-op Peters, and forms given by the computer
Optimized object activation window, improving performance
Made obtaining the Ice Super more explicitly require Ice Peter
Lowered a platform above the Snail room
Added more Easy mode platforms to Ice area
Reworked the Garden's vent maze to make more sense

tags.bug: Fixed a possible softlock in the Garden's yellow keyfruit puzzle
Fixed an issue where the gargoyle scene wouldn't play if you didn't save after beating the last elemental Peter

Moved a few banana peels to accommodate (and complement) the landmines
Savepoints can be reused, and are no longer "once-per-visit"

All gamepads can be configured independently, instead of only Slot 1
Gamepad bindings save to profiles based on GUID

notes.title: v1.0.18 Patch notes roundup
notes.content:
More patch notes for the last few versions. Mostly bug fixes with a few small features thrown in. Here are the major additions:
[list]
[*] VS mode has a random character button now.
[*] Performance mode was added. It basically just shrinks the area things are activated closer to the bounds of the view. Enable this if your game has trouble running at 60fps consistently in the main game.
[*] Lots of level design tweaks to make the game a little easier to explore.
[/list]
[h3]FULL PATCH NOTES[/h3]
v1.0.16
icicles can be dropped through, like thin platforms & tomatoes now
ending result now specifies if you played on custom mode
ending result text has a drop shadow now
ending now displays the game's version number
added a bridge at the beginning of the garden
changed second room of wind area to give players more time to react to fightzone
generally made the wind area easier to navigate
added more easy mode platforms
added a lot more hard mode bananas
fixed a bug where you could start a VS match with only one peter
added damage numbers to final bosses
made combo counter read as "-0 combo" when you recover from being comboed
^ (previously this read as "0x COMBO" in red text
fixed tomato vines being invisible during escape sequence
reweighed clear percentage and fixed inconsistency between ending/file select

v1.0.17
added another hint for secret vents
updated the pause map and fixed small inaccuracies
made unexplored map tiles black and added an outline
fixed some typos in the bestiary data
cleaned up the missile area and made it easier to explore
general improvements to level design
added performance mode

v1.0.18
fixed minor collision/tile misalignments
fixed some issues with performance mode
made it so you can unpause with (B/attack)
made it so you can back out of the options menu with (B/attack)
updated the credits, added a radio
slightly extended the database music
slightly slowed the escape sequence BG palette cycling
reduced amount of drones in escape sequence
adjusted hard mode bananas
made the cursors in VS mode wrap around the edges
added a random button to VS mode

tags.feature: [*] VS mode has a random character button now.

notes.title: v1.0.15 Steam AutoCloud support on Windows
notes.content:
Hi everyone. This round of hotfixes addresses issues with save data backups, as well as some level design tweaks.

Steam AutoCloud has been enabled for Windows. It is untested on Steam Deck at the moment, but should work assuming Proton Compatibility mode just simulates the Windows file path. I don't own a Steam Deck so if anyone can confirm that, that'd be cool.

[h2]PATCH NOTES[/h2]

v1.0.11
Save files can be transferred between devices now
made some of the swings wider

escape sequence missile part is easier now

added more easy mode platforms
hard mode has banana peels now
various level adjustments

v1.0.12 - v1.0.14 (Beta branch only)
Hotfixed & tested a lot of save backup issues (Thanks to SeymourSchlong)

lowercased the "a" in "are" in all references to the title, including the executable
fixed a bug where the ending result time could be 10-30 seconds longer, despite save file time

notes.title: v1.0.10 - Hotfix roundup, macOS port coming soon
notes.content:
Hi everyone, I hope you're all enjoying the game! Launch weekend was pretty crazy, but I appreciate everyone who submitted bug reports. We're on version 1.0.10 now, so I figured it's time to post the patch notes so far.

macOS version [i]should[/i] be up tomorrow. Kinda glad I waited on it considering the flaws in older versions. I don't own a new enough macbook to export the game myself, so the macOS version will likely get future patches a little late until I have a consistent way to export.

[h3]PATCH NOTES[/h3]

v1.0.1 removed delete key toggle for instance activation zone (aka the lag button)
v1.0.2 fixed disk #10 button puzzle in garden
v1.0.3 fixed final boss swapping bird/fighter forms
v1.0.4 fixed disk #7 softlock, escape sequence missile part easier
v1.0.5 fixed randomizer mode, re-enabled supermove notif

updated music
added jumping out of guard
re-recorded tutorial

changed default custom mode disk requirement to 3

fixed damage counter showing for burn status & throws
various level adjustments

v1.0.7
updated music
lowered main speedrun achievement to 2 hours
disabled all-CPU matches due to softlock on CSS
added dream bubble spawn effects to bird/fighter
fixed softlock by activating upper doors in computer room

v1.0.8
fixed bossrush (vs scientist) speedrun achievement
fixed inconsistent naming of "Peter's Dream" mode

v1.0.9
adjusted difficulty descriptions
fixed peter #7 text not showing up at all

fixed custom enemy difficulty not setting correctly

v1.0.10
fixed difficulty not setting outside custom mode after last hotfix
